raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner inconsistently applied release-date criteria, discarding Niyoti’s earlier verified India release (10 June 2016) in favor of a later “official worldwide” date (24 June 2016), while using Angali Pangali’s 17 June 2016 date. This misinterpretation and criteria shift led to the incorrect conclusion that Angali Pangali came out earlier, despite evidence that Niyoti was released first.
